rules.title: General prohibition on local rent control; exception
rules.requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. The exception is a city or town that accepts Chapter 40P, which may adopt rent control regulation only if, after six months, owner compliance is entirely voluntary, the regulation excludes units of owners holding less than ten rental units or units with a fair market rent exceeding $400, and the municipality compensates owners from its general funds for the difference between fair market rent and the controlled rent.
rules.coverage_text: All cities and towns in Massachusetts; bars local rent control except a limited, voluntary, compensated form in cities or towns that accept the chapter.
rules.exemptions: A city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation, but such regulation may not regulate occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or removal of properties from regulation, and may not apply to any rental unit owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units or that has a fair market rent exceeding $400; after six months from initial adoption, owner compliance must be entirely voluntary; the municipality must compensate owners from its general funds.
